blog_title: 100% Cotton T-Shirt Burn Test — ₹500 Polyester Fraud Exposed for Bulk Buyers in India
caption:
Ordered 220 GSM polos at ₹145? You're getting zero margin — or worse, fake GSM 😬

We broke down the real cost: ₹75 fabric + ₹25 stitching + ₹12 collar/buttons + ₹8 finishing + ₹10 packaging = ₹130 landed cost. That ₹145 price? After GST and returns, profit vanishes.

Fair polo rate starts at ₹160+. Anything lower = cut corners.

Save this post before your next bulk order 👇
